hero.description: An AI-assisted financial needs analysis tool that turns client data into advisor-ready recommendations.

detail.overviewDesc: AI FNA digitises financial needs analysis for advisors. We built guided data capture, an AI scoring and recommendation layer, and exportable client-ready reports.
detail.challengeDesc: Financial needs analysis was a manual, inconsistent interview, which made intake slow and the resulting recommendations hard to compare.
detail.builtDesc: We built an AI-assisted needs analysis that guides the client through structured questions, computes a needs profile and hands the advisor a consistent, reviewable output.

outcomes: Intake is consistent across every client
Advisors receive a comparable profile each time
Analysis time per client drops significantly
